decisions.reason: The click-in track adapter is a mechanical accessory that extends the firm's core track lighting system, so the firm understands it well and can keep supporting it at low cost.
An LED luminaire sits within the firm's core lighting knowledge, though fast LED generation cycles since 2018 make replacement by newer models plausible.

A home automation server box needs software and networking knowledge that lies far from the firm's luminaire expertise, so the firm can hardly interpret its results or improve it against specialised competitors.
The luminaire family had its own page and builds directly on the firm's core design and manufacturing capabilities, which favours keeping it and refining it.
